newsitem.title: POLAND: Salomon sees Polish Impexmetal IPO at $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Salomon sees Polish Impexmetal IPO at $40 mln.

text.p: The initial public offering of Polish metals trader Impexmetal SA, which seeks to enter the Warsaw bourse at mid-year, should be worth around $40 million, Salomon Brothers in London said in a report.
"The total proceeds of the series B issue (three million shares) should yield around $40 million," Salomon said in its market overview report on Poland dated January 27.

Salomon expected Impexmetal to use the funds to strengthen its capital investments in various domestic metal-producing firms, including copper firm KGHM Polska Miedz SA, and to upgrade technology at existing plants.
A KGHM IPO is also expected later this year.
Salomon said Impexmetal would continue to diversify towards production from trading, deriving around half its 1997 turnover from each segment.

The report said the firm's strengthening its relationships with copper, zinc, lead and aluminium producers in the coming years, possibly through capital investments, would make the firm less subject to political and economic influences.
It said such influences stemmed from the high employment in the steel sector and the sector's sensitivity to any downturn in the economy.
Salomon also said that Impexmetal's nine overseas offices positioned it well abroad.
It said local demand would also come from automotive, ball-bearing, household equipment, electric engine and farming machinery industries.
